# uyuni Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "uyuni" {
  host     = "192.168.1.100"
  username = "admin"
  password = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `username` (String)
